definitions.explanation: The last day of an event, period, exhibition, sale, or scheduled activity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{最終日|さいしゅうび}です。
⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最終日|さいしゅうび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駆|か}け{込|こ}んだ→駆け込む：06112_kakekomu⟧。
examples.english: I rushed in on the last day of the sale.

examples.japanese: ⟦{展覧会|てんらんかい}→展覧会：01470_tenrankai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最終日|さいしゅうび}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大勢|おおぜい}→大勢：02850_oozei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{来場者|らいじょうしゃ}→来場者：19023_raijousha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{混|こ}み{合|あ}って⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The exhibition was crowded with many visitors on its final day.

notes:
A straightforward compound of ⟦{最終|さいしゅう}→最終：02820_saishuu⟧ (final) and {日|び} (day). Very commonly seen on signs, advertisements, and schedules to indicate when something ends.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最終日|さいしゅうび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to reach the final day
- ⟦{開催|かいさい}→開催：10457_kaisai⟧{最終日|さいしゅうび}: last day of an event
- ⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧{最終日|さいしゅうび}: last day of business

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧: the last day (more conversational)
- ⟦{千秋楽|せんしゅうらく}→千秋楽：16501_senshuuraku⟧: final day of a performance run (theater, sumo)
- ⟦{初日|しょにち}→初日：11741_shonichi⟧: first day, opening day (opposite)
